context:
Goal: a merge tool whose every gate stops a real mistake and costs less than it saves.
Problem (goal): merge/merge.py has 337 commits in 8 days, 4,617 lines, and 27 debts name it (the consultant's count; unchecked by triage). Gates are fixed one misfire at a time, and nobody has read the whole. Whether it is stale is unmeasured.
Based on (measured): the consultant's counts above, unchecked; your 20:49 CST chat.
Departs from: main — adds one read-only audit; no gate changes until you pick from its table.
Meanwhile: the tool keeps running as it is; the wave plan does not wait on this.
lastAnswer: a, with an Opus agent: "yes send a opus agent to audit the merge tool" (owner 20:50 CST via the consultant).

options.gain: You see which gates are stale before more fixes pile on; nothing changes without your pick.
options.label: Audit it: one Sonnet agent tables each gate in merge.py with the ruling behind it and keep, fix or cut (recommended)
options.lose: One agent's run and your time reading its table.

options.label: No audit: fix gates as they misfire
options.lose: The fix pile keeps growing and a stale gate stays unseen.

owner: consultant (session_013NEJKz5AWFJhGvmCUoi6wQ), from your 20:49 CST chat; posted by triage (session_013NEJKzCzoWhfP8FMCPtQU6)
reply: Filed. The consultant's read-only Opus audit agent is running; its gate table (keep, fix, cut) comes back to you through the consultant, and nothing changes until you pick from it.
short: Audit every gate in the merge tool: keep, fix or cut?
title: A read-only audit of the merge tool?
why: You asked 20:49 whether the merge tool is any good and said it may be stale; one read-only agent can table every gate and say which to keep, fix or cut, with no change to the tool.
